name: iam
description: Identity and Access Management Identity and Access Management (IAM) is a web service for securely controlling access to Amazon Web Services services.

subcommands.name: accept-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Accepts a delegation request, granting the requested temporary access.

subcommands.name: add-client-id-to-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Adds a new client ID (also known as audience) to the list of client IDs already registered for the specified IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider resource.

subcommands.name: add-role-to-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Adds the specified IAM role to the specified instance profile.

subcommands.name: add-user-to-group
subcommands.description: Adds the specified user to the specified group.

subcommands.name: associate-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Associates a delegation request with the current identity.

subcommands.name: attach-group-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches the specified managed policy to the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: attach-role-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches the specified managed policy to the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: attach-user-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches the specified managed policy to the specified user.

subcommands.name: change-password
subcommands.description: Changes the password of the IAM user who is calling this operation.

subcommands.name: create-access-key
subcommands.description: Creates a new Amazon Web Services secret access key and corresponding Amazon Web Services access key ID for the specified user.

subcommands.name: create-account-alias
subcommands.description: Creates an alias for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM delegation request for temporary access delegation.

subcommands.name: create-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new group.

subcommands.name: create-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a new instance profile.

subcommands.name: create-login-profile
subcommands.description: Creates a password for the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: create-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM entity to describe an identity provider (IdP) that supports OpenID Connect (OIDC).

subcommands.name: create-policy
subcommands.description: Creates a new managed policy for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-policy-version
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of the specified managed policy.

subcommands.name: create-role
subcommands.description: Creates a new role for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM resource that describes an identity provider (IdP) that supports SAML 2.0.

subcommands.name: create-service-linked-role
subcommands.description: Creates an IAM role that is linked to a specific Amazon Web Services service.

subcommands.name: create-service-specific-credential
subcommands.description: Generates a set of credentials consisting of a user name and password that can be used to access the service specified in the request.

subcommands.name: create-user
subcommands.description: Creates a new IAM user for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: create-virtual-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Creates a new virtual MFA device for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: deactivate-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Deactivates the specified MFA device and removes it from association with the user name for which it was originally enabled.

subcommands.name: delete-access-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the access key pair associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: delete-account-alias
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified Amazon Web Services account alias.

subcommands.name: delete-account-password-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the password policy for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: delete-group
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: delete-group-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified inline policy that is embedded in the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: delete-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified instance profile.

subcommands.name: delete-login-profile
subcommands.description: Deletes the password for the specified IAM user or root user, For more information, see Managing passwords for IAM users.

subcommands.name: delete-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Deletes an OpenID Connect identity provider (IdP) resource object in IAM.

subcommands.name: delete-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified managed policy.

subcommands.name: delete-policy-version
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified version from the specified managed policy.

subcommands.name: delete-role
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified role.

subcommands.name: delete-role-permissions-boundary
subcommands.description: Deletes the permissions boundary for the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: delete-role-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified inline policy that is embedded in the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: delete-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Deletes a SAML provider resource in IAM.

subcommands.name: delete-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified server certificate.

subcommands.name: delete-service-linked-role
subcommands.description: Submits a service-linked role deletion request and returns a DeletionTaskId, which you can use to check the status of the deletion.

subcommands.name: delete-service-specific-credential
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified service-specific credential.

subcommands.name: delete-signing-certificate
subcommands.description: Deletes a signing certificate associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: delete-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified SSH public key.

subcommands.name: delete-user
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: delete-user-permissions-boundary
subcommands.description: Deletes the permissions boundary for the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: delete-user-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified inline policy that is embedded in the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: delete-virtual-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Deletes a virtual MFA device.

subcommands.name: detach-group-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the specified managed policy from the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: detach-role-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the specified managed policy from the specified role.

subcommands.name: detach-user-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the specified managed policy from the specified user.

subcommands.name: disable-organizations-root-credentials-management
subcommands.description: Disables the management of privileged root user credentials across member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: disable-organizations-root-sessions
subcommands.description: Disables root user sessions for privileged tasks across member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: disable-outbound-web-identity-federation
subcommands.description: Disables the outbound identity federation feature for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: enable-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Enables the specified MFA device and associates it with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: enable-organizations-root-credentials-management
subcommands.description: Enables the management of privileged root user credentials across member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: enable-organizations-root-sessions
subcommands.description: Allows the management account or delegated administrator to perform privileged tasks on member accounts in your organization.

subcommands.name: enable-outbound-web-identity-federation
subcommands.description: Enables the outbound identity federation feature for your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: generate-credential-report
subcommands.description: Generates a credential report for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: generate-organizations-access-report
subcommands.description: Generates a report for service last accessed data for Organizations.

subcommands.name: generate-service-last-accessed-details
subcommands.description: Generates a report that includes details about when an IAM resource (user, group, role, or policy) was last used in an attempt to access Amazon Web Services services.

subcommands.name: get-access-key-last-used
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about when the specified access key was last used.

subcommands.name: get-account-authorization-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about all IAM users, groups, roles, and policies in your Amazon Web Services account, including their relationships to one another.

subcommands.name: get-account-password-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the password policy for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-account-summary
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about IAM entity usage and IAM quotas in the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-context-keys-for-custom-policy
subcommands.description: Gets a list of all of the context keys referenced in the input policies.

subcommands.name: get-context-keys-for-principal-policy
subcommands.description: Gets a list of all of the context keys referenced in all the IAM policies that are attached to the specified IAM entity.

subcommands.name: get-credential-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves a credential report for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific delegation request.

subcommands.name: get-group
subcommands.description: Returns a list of IAM users that are in the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: get-group-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified inline policy document that is embedded in the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: get-human-readable-summary
subcommands.description: Retrieves a human readable summary for a given entity.

subcommands.name: get-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified instance profile, including the instance profile's path, GUID, ARN, and role.

subcommands.name: get-login-profile
subcommands.description: Retrieves the user name for the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: get-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about an MFA device for a specified user.

subcommands.name: get-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider resource object in IAM.

subcommands.name: get-organizations-access-report
subcommands.description: Retrieves the service last accessed data report for Organizations that was previously generated using the GenerateOrganizationsAccessReport operation.

subcommands.name: get-outbound-web-identity-federation-info
subcommands.description: Retrieves the configuration information for the outbound identity federation feature in your Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: get-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified managed policy, including the policy's default version and the total number of IAM users, groups, and roles to which the policy is attached.

subcommands.name: get-policy-version
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified version of the specified managed policy, including the policy document.

subcommands.name: get-role
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified role, including the role's path, GUID, ARN, and the role's trust policy that grants permission to assume the role.

subcommands.name: get-role-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified inline policy document that is embedded with the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: get-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Returns the SAML provider metadocument that was uploaded when the IAM SAML provider resource object was created or updated.

subcommands.name: get-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified server certificate stored in IAM.

subcommands.name: get-service-last-accessed-details
subcommands.description: Retrieves a service last accessed report that was created using the GenerateServiceLastAccessedDetails operation.

subcommands.name: get-service-last-accessed-details-with-entities
subcommands.description: After you generate a group or policy report using the GenerateServiceLastAccessedDetails operation, you can use the JobId parameter in GetServiceLastAccessedDetailsWithEntities.

subcommands.name: get-service-linked-role-deletion-status
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status of your service-linked role deletion.

subcommands.name: get-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified SSH public key, including metadata about the key.

subcommands.name: get-user
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about the specified IAM user, including the user's creation date, path, unique ID, and ARN.

subcommands.name: get-user-policy
subcommands.description: Retrieves the specified inline policy document that is embedded in the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-access-keys
subcommands.description: Returns information about the access key IDs associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-account-aliases
subcommands.description: Lists the account alias associated with the Amazon Web Services account (Note: you can have only one).

subcommands.name: list-attached-group-policies
subcommands.description: Lists all managed policies that are attached to the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: list-attached-role-policies
subcommands.description: Lists all managed policies that are attached to the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: list-attached-user-policies
subcommands.description: Lists all managed policies that are attached to the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-delegation-requests
subcommands.description: Lists delegation requests based on the specified criteria.

subcommands.name: list-entities-for-policy
subcommands.description: Lists all IAM users, groups, and roles that the specified managed policy is attached to.

subcommands.name: list-group-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the names of the inline policies that are embedded in the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: list-groups
subcommands.description: Lists the IAM groups that have the specified path prefix.

subcommands.name: list-groups-for-user
subcommands.description: Lists the IAM groups that the specified IAM user belongs to.

subcommands.name: list-instance-profile-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified IAM instance profile.

subcommands.name: list-instance-profiles
subcommands.description: Lists the instance profiles that have the specified path prefix.

subcommands.name: list-instance-profiles-for-role
subcommands.description: Lists the instance profiles that have the specified associated IAM role.

subcommands.name: list-mfa-device-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified IAM virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device.

subcommands.name: list-mfa-devices
subcommands.description: Lists the MFA devices for an IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-open-id-connect-provider-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified OpenID Connect (OIDC)-compatible identity provider.

subcommands.name: list-open-id-connect-providers
subcommands.description: Lists information about the IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider resource objects defined in the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: list-organizations-features
subcommands.description: Lists the centralized root access features enabled for your organization.

subcommands.name: list-policies
subcommands.description: Lists all the managed policies that are available in your Amazon Web Services account, including your own customer-defined managed policies and all Amazon Web Services managed policies.

subcommands.name: list-policies-granting-service-access
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of policies that the IAM identity (user, group, or role) can use to access each specified service.

subcommands.name: list-policy-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified IAM customer managed policy.

subcommands.name: list-policy-versions
subcommands.description: Lists information about the versions of the specified managed policy, including the version that is currently set as the policy's default version.

subcommands.name: list-role-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the names of the inline policies that are embedded in the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: list-role-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified role.

subcommands.name: list-roles
subcommands.description: Lists the IAM roles that have the specified path prefix.

subcommands.name: list-saml-provider-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) identity provider.

subcommands.name: list-saml-providers
subcommands.description: Lists the SAML provider resource objects defined in IAM in the account.

subcommands.name: list-server-certificate-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified IAM server certificate.

subcommands.name: list-server-certificates
subcommands.description: Lists the server certificates stored in IAM that have the specified path prefix.

subcommands.name: list-service-specific-credentials
subcommands.description: Returns information about the service-specific credentials associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-signing-certificates
subcommands.description: Returns information about the signing certificates associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-ssh-public-keys
subcommands.description: Returns information about the SSH public keys associated with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-user-policies
subcommands.description: Lists the names of the inline policies embedded in the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-user-tags
subcommands.description: Lists the tags that are attached to the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: list-users
subcommands.description: Lists the IAM users that have the specified path prefix.

subcommands.name: list-virtual-mfa-devices
subcommands.description: Lists the virtual MFA devices defined in the Amazon Web Services account by assignment status.

subcommands.name: put-group-policy
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an inline policy document that is embedded in the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: put-role-permissions-boundary
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the policy that is specified as the IAM role's permissions boundary.

subcommands.name: put-role-policy
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an inline policy document that is embedded in the specified IAM role.

subcommands.name: put-user-permissions-boundary
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the policy that is specified as the IAM user's permissions boundary.

subcommands.name: put-user-policy
subcommands.description: Adds or updates an inline policy document that is embedded in the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: reject-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Rejects a delegation request, denying the requested temporary access.

subcommands.name: remove-client-id-from-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Removes the specified client ID (also known as audience) from the list of client IDs registered for the specified IAM OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider resource object.

subcommands.name: remove-role-from-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Removes the specified IAM role from the specified Amazon EC2 instance profile.

subcommands.name: remove-user-from-group
subcommands.description: Removes the specified user from the specified group.

subcommands.name: reset-service-specific-credential
subcommands.description: Resets the password for a service-specific credential.

subcommands.name: resync-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Synchronizes the specified MFA device with its IAM resource object on the Amazon Web Services servers.

subcommands.name: send-delegation-token
subcommands.description: Sends the exchange token for an accepted delegation request.

subcommands.name: set-default-policy-version
subcommands.description: Sets the specified version of the specified policy as the policy's default (operative) version.

subcommands.name: set-security-token-service-preferences
subcommands.description: Sets the specified version of the global endpoint token as the token version used for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: simulate-custom-policy
subcommands.description: Simulate how a set of IAM policies and optionally a resource-based policy works with a list of API operations and Amazon Web Services resources to determine the policies' effective permissions.

subcommands.name: simulate-principal-policy
subcommands.description: Simulate how a set of IAM policies attached to an IAM entity works with a list of API operations and Amazon Web Services resources to determine the policies' effective permissions.

subcommands.name: tag-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM instance profile.

subcommands.name: tag-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device.

subcommands.name: tag-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an OpenID Connect (OIDC)-compatible identity provider.

subcommands.name: tag-policy
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM customer managed policy.

subcommands.name: tag-role
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM role.

subcommands.name: tag-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to a Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) identity provider.

subcommands.name: tag-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM server certificate.

subcommands.name: tag-user
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to an IAM user.

subcommands.name: untag-instance-profile
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the IAM instance profile.

subcommands.name: untag-mfa-device
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the IAM virtual multi-factor authentication (MFA) device.

subcommands.name: untag-open-id-connect-provider
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified OpenID Connect (OIDC)-compatible identity provider in IAM.

subcommands.name: untag-policy
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the customer managed policy.

subcommands.name: untag-role
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the role.

subcommands.name: untag-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the specified Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) identity provider in IAM.

subcommands.name: untag-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the IAM server certificate.

subcommands.name: untag-user
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags from the user.

subcommands.name: update-access-key
subcommands.description: Changes the status of the specified access key from Active to Inactive, or vice versa.

subcommands.name: update-account-password-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the password policy settings for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: update-assume-role-policy
subcommands.description: Updates the policy that grants an IAM entity permission to assume a role.

subcommands.name: update-delegation-request
subcommands.description: Updates an existing delegation request with additional information.

subcommands.name: update-group
subcommands.description: Updates the name and/or the path of the specified IAM group.

subcommands.name: update-login-profile
subcommands.description: Changes the password for the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: update-open-id-connect-provider-thumbprint
subcommands.description: Replaces the existing list of server certificate thumbprints associated with an OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider resource object with a new list of thumbprints.

subcommands.name: update-role
subcommands.description: Updates the description or maximum session duration setting of a role.

subcommands.name: update-role-description
subcommands.description: Use UpdateRole instead.

subcommands.name: update-saml-provider
subcommands.description: Updates the metadata document, SAML encryption settings, and private keys for an existing SAML provider.

subcommands.name: update-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Updates the name and/or the path of the specified server certificate stored in IAM.

subcommands.name: update-service-specific-credential
subcommands.description: Sets the status of a service-specific credential to Active or Inactive.

subcommands.name: update-signing-certificate
subcommands.description: Changes the status of the specified user signing certificate from active to disabled, or vice versa.

subcommands.name: update-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Sets the status of an IAM user's SSH public key to active or inactive.

subcommands.name: update-user
subcommands.description: Updates the name and/or the path of the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: upload-server-certificate
subcommands.description: Uploads a server certificate entity for the Amazon Web Services account.

subcommands.name: upload-signing-certificate
subcommands.description: Uploads an X.509 signing certificate and associates it with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: upload-ssh-public-key
subcommands.description: Uploads an SSH public key and associates it with the specified IAM user.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: instance-profile-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``get-instance-profile``.

subcommands.name: policy-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``get-policy``.

subcommands.name: role-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``get-role``.

subcommands.name: user-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until 200 response is received when polling with ``get-user``.
